d: At least 31 people were killed and 21 injured after a fuel tanker crashed and exploded on Cairo's Ring Road in Egypt's Giza Governorate on Wednesday. According to Egypt's Petroleum Ministry, the privately operated tanker veered off the road before crashing, triggering a massive blaze that spread to nearby vehicles. Authorities dispatched 39 ambulances, taking the injured to three hospitals. Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi offered condolences and directed officials to assist victims and restore traffic.
